cache_keys_without_ttl_note: No infinite cache keys discovered. Every Cache::put / Cache::add / Cache::remember site verified with explicit TTL.
cache_keys_never_invalidated_note: All discovered writes are EITHER (a) listener-invalidated on relevant domain events (kiosk.menu.branch.{id}), (b) atomically bumped (menu:snapshot_version), OR (c) intentionally TTL-only (observability, idempotency replay, throttle, locks, summaries). The TTL-only keys are correctly bounded for their semantics: ws:heartbeat=120s, kds.sync=5s, stock_scan_rupture=1d, availability:decremented=24h, stock_low_alert=throttle_seconds(3600s), change_payment_status=24h, fiscal/queue/idempotency locks=5-30s.
tags_used_note: Grep `Cache::tags|cache()->tags` returns ZERO results. Redis cache-tag store is not configured (config/cache.php uses default Redis without tagged store). All invalidation uses explicit Cache::forget per key — appropriate for current key cardinality (one key per branch).
uni_03_status_note: BRAIN §8 production boot guard at app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:295 keeps the narrower `['array', 'null']` forbidden list. `file` and `database` drivers PASS the guard despite the block-comment intent of 'redis or memcached'. Doc says V1.0.X cloud-prep UNI-03 backlog. CURRENT .env CACHE_DRIVER=redis verified — V1 LOCAL is safe by configuration. Gap remains a deferred V1.0.X widen-list item (only bites if cloud cutover deploys with CACHE_DRIVER=file across multi-instance ALB).

cross_worker_coherence_detail.v1_local_lecayenne: Single-box. .env CACHE_DRIVER=redis (not file). NF525 Cache::lock(audit_chain_b{n}) + Cache::lock(fiscal_seq_b{n}) achieve cross-worker coherence via shared Redis. SAFE.
cross_worker_coherence_detail.v2_cloud_alb_multi_instance: If deployed with file driver, Cache::lock becomes per-process (file driver uses local filesystem locks — not shared across instances). Two PHP-FPM instances could insert audit_log rows colliding on UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) or skip a fiscal_sequence_no. The boot guard does NOT block this misconfiguration today. UNI-03 V1.0.X backlog widens forbiddenCacheDrivers to ['array','null','file','database'].
cross_worker_coherence_detail.session_driver: SESSION_DRIVER=file per .env (config/session.php default). Single-box V1 OK; multi-instance cloud requires SESSION_DRIVER=redis or database to share auth state.

adversarial_findings.title: Listener ordering inverted for ItemAvailabilityChanged — snapshot bump runs BEFORE cache forget
adversarial_findings.evidence: app/Providers/EventServiceProvider.php:201-209 — BumpMenuSnapshotOnItemAvailabilityChanged is registered first, InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged second. Both are synchronous in-process listeners.
adversarial_findings.race_scenario: Kiosk poll thread hits /api/admin/menu-projection BETWEEN the two listeners → reads bumped snapshot_version → kicks /api/frontend/menu fetch → reads STILL-CACHED stale payload (forget hasn't fired yet). Window is sub-millisecond inside a single request thread.
adversarial_findings.correct_order_reference: InvalidateMenuProjectionOnIngredientChange::forgetBranch (line 51-53) does forget BEFORE bump in the same method body — the canonical pattern. InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange::forgetBranch (line 51-53) also does forget BEFORE bump.
adversarial_findings.exploitability: Theoretical only — same-thread synchronous listener stack, window measured in microseconds. Not V1 reproducible without an artificial async dispatcher injected mid-stack.
adversarial_findings.fix: Swap order in EventServiceProvider.php:202 vs 206: InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged FIRST, BumpMenuSnapshotOnItemAvailabilityChanged SECOND. Aligns with the catalog/ingredient pattern.

adversarial_findings.title: Doc rot — comment says '5-minute TTL', actual TTL is 60 seconds
adversarial_findings.evidence: app/Services/ItemService.php:399 comment: 'broadcast item change to all kiosk displays so they can update their menu cache without waiting for the 5-minute TTL'. Actual: config('kiosk.menu_cache_ttl', 60) = 60 seconds (MenuController.php:66, EventServiceProvider.php:248 doc).
adversarial_findings.exploitability: None — comment-only confusion for next maintainer reading C3 broadcast intent.

adversarial_findings.title: Cross-customer write race: two admins reprice same item simultaneously
adversarial_findings.evidence: ItemService::update wraps the work in a DB::transaction with afterCommit ItemUpdated dispatch. Listener stack is per-event (both admins fire their own event sequence). Final DB state reflects last writer (DB-level last-write-wins). Cache::forget is idempotent — both invalidations run, both refresh broadcasts fire. Final cache fill happens on the next /api/frontend/menu hit which reads the committed DB state.
adversarial_findings.exploitability: Race resolves correctly because cache is invalidated TWICE and refilled ONCE post-commit from DB SoT. No stale state can persist.

adversarial_findings.title: Cache key collision risk — flat keyspace, no domain prefix discipline
adversarial_findings.evidence: Keys span: kiosk.menu.branch.*, menu:snapshot_version:branch:*, kds.sync.*, stock_scan_rupture:*, availability:decremented:*, stock_low_alert:*, change_payment_status:*, ws:heartbeat, fiscal_seq_b*, audit_chain_b*, z_report_b*, queue_lock_*, pos_order_idempotency_*, frontend_order_idempotency_*, payment_reconcile_lock, fiscal_archive_lock, outbox_retry_lock. Mix of `.` separator (`kiosk.menu.branch.42`) and `_` separator (`fiscal_seq_b42`) — convention is not enforced anywhere.
adversarial_findings.exploitability: No collision observed today — each key is unique within its prefix. Risk surfaces when a future heal reuses the prefix carelessly.
adversarial_findings.fix: V1.0.X backlog — add a `domain:branch:{id}:{op}` convention via a CacheKey helper. Defer; current keys are stable.

adversarial_findings.title: Redis maxmemory eviction policy not enforced at boot
adversarial_findings.evidence: No boot guard verifies Redis `maxmemory-policy` is set to `allkeys-lru` or `volatile-lru`. Default policy `noeviction` returns OOM errors on Cache::put when maxmemory hits — silent broadcast/observability failures.
adversarial_findings.exploitability: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box with low Redis usage — practically unbounded. V2 cloud Redis sizing must be planned.
adversarial_findings.fix: V1.0.X cloud-prep backlog — add Redis health probe + maxmemory-policy verifier.

verdict_rationale: Cache invalidation discipline is correct for V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne. Every write has explicit TTL. The critical chain (admin rename/reprice → kiosk visible) is healed end-to-end via ItemUpdated event → InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnCatalogChange (commit GOAL-I2-HEAL-02 2026-05-24 verified). Pricing has no cache layer (SSOT integrity over latency). MenuSnapshot is monotonically bumped + 7d TTL. NF525 Cache::lock cross-worker coherence holds with current Redis driver. Tags not used but not required at current key cardinality. Two V1.0.X backlog items already tracked (UNI-03 widen forbiddenCacheDrivers list + listener ordering inversion). Five adversarial findings logged — none V1 blockers.
